name: zepp-apps
description: Zepp OS watch face and mini apps for the Amazfit Cheetah (Square): an app-launcher watch face, a calorie/protein tracker, a weather app and a daily task list

scripts.build: npm run build:watchface && npm run build:launcher && npm run build:nutrition && npm run build:weather && npm run build:tasks
scripts.screens: node --import ./test/support/register.mjs tools/preview.mjs watchface && node --import ./test/support/register.mjs tools/preview.mjs launcher && node --import ./test/support/register.mjs tools/preview.mjs nutrition && node --import ./test/support/register.mjs tools/preview.mjs weather && node --import ./test/support/register.mjs tools/preview.mjs tasks
